name: context-meter
description: Shows the git branch, context window usage, what the last turn added, and plan limit usage above the prompt

showBranch.title: Branch
showBranch.description: Show the current git branch. Nothing is shown outside a git repository.

showDirty.title: Uncommitted changes mark
showDirty.description: Add * to the branch name when the working tree has uncommitted changes. Runs git status on each turn.

showContext.title: Context (Ctx)
showContext.description: Show how full the context window is.

showLastTurn.title: Last turn (Last)
showLastTurn.description: Show how many tokens the last turn added.

showFiveHour.title: Five-hour limit (5H)
showFiveHour.description: Show how much of the five-hour plan limit is used.

showWeekly.title: Weekly limit (1W)
showWeekly.description: Show how much of the weekly plan limit is used.

showOtherLimits.title: Other limits
showOtherLimits.description: Show any other limit your account reports, such as a gateway's spend limit.

showResetTimes.title: Reset times
showResetTimes.description: Show when each limit resets, where the band is wide enough.

showCost.title: Session cost
showCost.description: Show what the session has cost in US dollars. On a subscription plan this is an estimate at API prices, not a charge.
